mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 800K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 800K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200K jobs/mo, a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% YoY increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during supply chain strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $420B and GDPC1 growth surpasses 3% QoQ, robust demand and GDP growth boost corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 25bp increase in FEDFUNDS within a month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by 25bp, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 7%) is associated with a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns during low UNRATE periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and CPIAUCSL both increase by > 1% MoM, supply chain resilience and moderate inflation support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and CPIAUCSL both increase by > 1% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
